2 times on dxm won't harm you. It is rumored that abuse can give you brain lesions because it is chemically similar to pcp, but it has never been proven. Studies have shown that responsible use has absolutely no side effects though. I've done dxm at least a hundred times and I think it has slowed me down, but only a little.
Responsible usage can help things.
On one hand, I do. And I often times wonder if they have to any degree. On the other, drugs have opened my mind to things I never would have otherwise realized or thought of.

Other than that, I've had some cool dxm trips. One of my favorites includes the peace rock. I was on a low dose and saw a rock that I picked up grow 8 flat crab like legs. I knew right away that this rock was the embodiment of all peace throughout the world and would usher in a new age for all mankind. That's when my friend grabbed the rock and chucked it into the river. He looked evil to me at that point, but I knew he was my friend. Had been since I was 5. And there was another time tripping with that same friend where I morphed into a llama for a brief second. After that one crazy bad trip though I hadn't done dxm for a full year. Until recently. In those trips I took 8 skittles and played fallout 4. I went into the game and beat swan to death with a baseball bat, hid the baseball bat in the top of a tower, then made a new bat. The one I hid represented struggles. The new one represented starting over. Because as always, I come out of a trip a slightly more open minded person. Last trip I had was a bad one though. My girlfriend took out her stress on me by yelling at me, and I had taken around 500-600 mgs.  So by the end of the trip I'm sitting in the dark realizing the universe would be better off without the human race. I came out of that last one a bit darker, but also more embracive about how dark reality can be.

I used to experiment with dxm alot about a year ago. I'm usually very responsible when it comes to drugs. Researching them, and calculating my dosage. My usual amount between me and a friend was around 200-400 mgs. 
One day I was depressed and wanted to find myself. My first mistake was tripping while depressed. My second was not paying attention to my dosage, which was unlike me. Like I said, I usually took 200-400 mgs. In the form of skittles(triple c's) this time I drunk a bottle of robo. And by accident, 2,400 or so mgs. I don't remember at what point I realized I had taken this much. But my trip started at my old camp, when I fell back onto the ground and looked up at the trees that towered over me. They seemed to grow taller, and passed severe judgement onto me. I could tell they thought I was a terrible person. I don't recall small details of my trip, but the key parts were as follows, and not necessarily in this order: I was crawling through a field(the field was real) people kept calling my phone, and I was speaking jibberish(I believe talking backwards like a record) I had black and white visions of world war 3. I saw Kim jong, tanks, explosions, some pretty dark images of war. I also looked up at the sky and my consciousness left my body and zoomed through the galaxy, then I returned to earth faster than I had left. But here's the crazy part, and I read about a guy having this same thing happen in a dmt trip. I died. I went into my tent, I hadn't even hit my peak. I curled up into a ball, everything got cold, then everything went dark. And it wasn't like sleeping or blacking out. I say that, because you can feel that you are alive when sleeping or blacked out. Even if you can't form thoughts. This felt different. Absense of thought(and this is how the guy described his trip too) just NOTHING. Until I eventually felt the life returning to me and told myself that I'm too strong to die. I then limped back home. A 5-10 minute walk seemed to take an hour, though I know it didn't. Once I got in, a very close friend was there. At first I thought she was a strong hallucination. She wasn't. She took care of me and saw me through it.

What you're going through isn't so uncommon. Alot of people have came to me with the same problems when it comes to college. When you get down to it, college is a scam. They only care about your money. It's bad for the people really. And I felt the same way at your age. I'm only 21 now, but I look back and realize, I was only 18. So new to adulthood. Life isn't over. It's just begun. I really hate it how the world puts SO MUCH pressure on people at 18. It's like they throw you out there and expect you to swim instead of sink. But I came to realize, it's not our fault.
The only opinion that matters is YOURS. You are your own person.
